briefdescription.para: Creates a full PTY-backed session and stores it by UUID.

detaileddescription.para: Delegates to terminal::Session::create(cwd, cols, rows, shell, args, seedEnv, uuid). Session exit is signalled via the State shellExited parameter, which flows to registered VT listeners via the VT flush chain. Fires a child-added event on events after the session is stored.

cwd
Initial working directory. Empty = inherit.
dims
Terminal dimensions in cells. Must be valid.
shell
Shell program override. Empty = read from Config.
args
Shell arguments override. Empty = read from Config.
seedEnv
Extra environment variables merged before shell open.
uuid
Explicit UUID to assign. Must be non-empty.
Mutable reference to the newly constructed terminal::Session.
NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
Fires a child-added event on events after the session is stored so that registered listeners (Daemon, Link) can react to the new session.

memberdef.name: create

briefdescription.para: Creates a remote (no-TTY) session and stores it by UUID.

detaileddescription.para: Delegates to terminal::Session::create(cols, rows, cwd, shell, uuid). Used in client mode where the daemon owns the PTY. CWD and shell are written to State so display logic works without waiting for a stateUpdate PDU. Fires a child-added event on events after the session is stored.

dims
Terminal dimensions in cells (width = cols, height = rows). Must be valid.
cwd
Initial working directory — written to State.
shell
Shell program name — written to State for displayName logic.
uuid
Explicit UUID to assign. Must be non-empty.
Mutable reference to the newly constructed terminal::Session.
NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
Fires a child-added event on events after the session is stored.

Routes internally based on mode:
client: creates a remote (no-TTY) session; fires events child-added which Link observes to send the createSession PDU and wire IPC.
standalone / daemon: creates a full PTY-backed session; fires events child-added which Daemon observes to wire IPC callbacks.
Returns the existing session immediately if uuid already exists (idempotency guard for GUI reconnect).

cwd
Initial working directory. Empty = inherit.
uuid
Explicit UUID to assign. Must be non-empty.
cols
Initial column count. Must be > 0.
rows
Initial row count. Must be > 0.
Mutable reference to the terminal::Session (use getProcessor() for the Processor).
NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
Routes based on mode:
Client mode: creates remote session and lets the events VT event notify Link.
Standalone/daemon mode: creates PTY-backed session; events VT event notifies Daemon.
Returns the existing session immediately if uuid already exists (idempotency guard for GUI reconnect).
